title: Python receiver replay cache: key on claim_seq high-water per gateway IID (not superframe_id)
description: Child of l1qw.20 (receiver semantics leg, Python). SlotClaimReplayCache (python/src/lichen/gateway/slot_claim.py:358-393) is in-memory and keyed on superframe_id; spec/08 step 8 + persistence table mandate reject iff claim_seq <= cached claim_seq for that gateway IID, independent of superframe, with persist-before-apply. Align with Rust fix (l1qw.20.4) and test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.json claim_seq_replay_equal/lower. If the cache's file-backed persistence is out of an in-memory class's shape, note the gap in the close reason rather than expanding scope.
